title: Word Categories Worksheets | Kindergarten Reading Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: L.K.5a

Give your learners extra practice with Word Categories! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
